## Summary

The ticket's named item — "`arm`/`experiment`/`lineage` kinds with
S8–S9, `ReproReport{independent}`, `BundleStatusRecord`,
`PublicationPolicy`, foreign import/export" — was almost entirely
landed by S4.2 (scoped kinds, S8–S9, status ladder, publication
policy, import/export machinery) and S4.3 (results-store C1). This
run lands the three genuine gaps found by the gap analysis:

**`ReproReport{independent}` is now real.** The report carries
`reproducer` (the declared `ProvenanceRecord`), `reproducer_instrument`
(`{version_id, component_versions?, installation_id?}`), `independent`
(kernel-computed — never read from the request; a caller-supplied flag
is ignored by construction), and the spec's four-valued `verdict`
(`reproduced | not_reproduced | inconclusive | n/a{reason}`, derived
from `outcome` — the interim member stays, CC8 additive).
`kernel.reproduce` accepts `reproducer{provenance, instrument}`;
absent, the kernel's own provenance is stamped — repeatability, and
the flag honestly computes `false`. `compute_independence` is
fail-closed over declared material: BOTH the `attestation.anchor.signer`
and `installation_id` axes must resolve on both sides and differ;
every other case names its basis on `evidence.independent_basis`
(`same_signer`, `same_installation`, `*_undeclared`). OQ-334's
establishment half (verifying the reproducer's claim under §05g) is
the C2/Stage-5 `reproduced`-status item — the interim rule is a strict
floor under whatever it ratifies.

**The `reproduced` gate binds its evidence.** `set_status{to:
reproduced}` now requires `repro_report.bundle_id == bundle_ref` in
addition to `verdict = reproduced` and `independent = true` — a
`ReproReport` is evidence for its named bundle, never a transferable
badge (CC2). This is also the first produced-report path that can
satisfy the gate (it previously read members no real report emitted).

**`lab.leaderboard.snapshots` closes the §6.5 §2.2 read surface.**
`{definition|definition_ref}` → `{definition_id, snapshots:
[snapshot_id]}` over the persisted per-definition index —
`snapshot_leaderboard` appends, the op reads (the store function
landed at S4.3 without a boundary op). `hh-embed-schema` ops table +
regenerated artifacts carry it.
